stem: Which idea should follow and support sentence 23?

options.label: A
options.text: The orange spots warn other animals and insects that the butterfly is poisonous.

options.label: B
options.text: Monarch butterflies have a black body, and the outer edge of their wings is lined in black.

options.label: C
options.text: This butterfly migrates each year, leaving its home during the winter months for warmer climates.

options.label: D
options.text: Monarch butterflies, which are one of the most well-known butterflies in North America, are quite stunning.
